title: Settings
void_window_help: How many hours after a sale it can still be corrected. Default 24.
invalid_hours: Please enter a valid positive number of hours.

pin.title: Owner PIN Required
pin.locked_out: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
pin.pin_mismatch: PINs do not match. Try again.
pin.recovery_desc: Write down or copy this recovery code. It will only be shown once and is required if you forget your PIN.
pin.verify_failed: Could not verify your PIN. Please try again.

biometrics.toggle_use_biometrics_help: Approve owner actions with your fingerprint or face instead of typing the PIN. The PIN always still works.
biometrics.toggle_launch_lock_help: Ask for your fingerprint, face, or PIN when the app opens. Reopening within five minutes will not ask again.
biometrics.requires_pin: Set up an Owner PIN first.
biometrics.not_available: This phone has no fingerprint or face sensor.
biometrics.not_enrolled: Register a fingerprint or face in your phone settings first.
biometrics.risk_title: Anyone enrolled on this phone can approve
biometrics.risk_body: Every fingerprint and face registered on this phone will be able to approve voids, refunds, credit limit overrides, stock adjustments, and restores without knowing your PIN. Turn this on only if you are the only person enrolled.
biometrics.lock_subtitle: Confirm it is you to continue.
